summary: Verified the new 'Accounting section lock' feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend endpoint POST /api/auth/verify-password works correctly for pharmacy, supplier, and admin: correct pw → 200 {ok:true}; wrong/empty pw → 401 with Arabic detail 'رمز غير صحيح'; missing Authorization header → 401; cross-account passwords are rejected (supplier account rejects pharmacy pw). Password rotation is honoured — after DB-level rotation of pharmacy pw from pass123 → 123456, verify-password rejects pass123 and accepts 123456 (proving the unlock code == login pw, no separate storage). All 9 feature-specific pytest cases pass (test_accounting_unlock.py). Frontend E2E: login → tap tile-accounting redirects to /accounting/unlock; screen renders logo, title 'أدخل رمز الأمان', subtitle 'لفتح قسم الحسابات', 3x4 keypad key-0..key-9 + key-back + key-submit, and pin-box placeholder '••••'. Wrong PIN 9999 → pin-error appears with exact text 'رمز غير صحيح', input clears, still on /accounting/unlock. Correct PIN 123456 (after temporary DB rotation) → /accounting shows all four cards (ربح اليوم, ربح الشهر, قيمة المخزون, إجمالي الديون). Session persistence: SPA nav back to /home and re-tap tile does NOT re-prompt. Sign out → sign in → tap tile does re-prompt (unlock flag cleared by resetAccountingLock in signOut). Pharmacy pw restored to pass123 after tests. No blocking issues found in the feature.

minor.issue: Endpoint is called by frontend app/settings/password.tsx (line 27) but is NOT implemented in backend/server.py — no route handler exists for this path. Users tapping 'تغيير كلمة السر' from settings will get a 404. Out of scope of the accounting-lock review but is directly relevant because the review depended on this path to rotate passwords — we had to rotate via MongoDB directly. Recommend implementing PATCH /me/password (current_password, new_password) which validates current pw and updates pharmacies/suppliers based on role.

issues: Keypad is numeric-only by design (per user requirement). Seed pharmacy pw 'pass123' contains letters and CANNOT be entered via this keypad. This is user-facing: pharmacies MUST set a numeric login password before this section is usable. Suggest documenting this in onboarding, or forcing a numeric-pw policy at register time, or falling back to a text field for alphanumeric passwords.

react_native_issues.issue: useNativeDriver: true causes web console warning 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported... falling back to JS-based animation'. Harmless on native; on web it degrades gracefully. Consider Platform.OS !== 'web' for useNativeDriver to suppress the warning. Reference: /app/frontend/app/accounting/unlock.tsx:46-52

action_items: (optional) Implement PATCH /api/me/password on backend to match the frontend settings/password.tsx call — this bug pre-exists but blocks the settings 'change password' flow.
(optional) Consider Platform.OS !== 'web' guard for useNativeDriver in unlock.tsx shake animation to suppress the web warning.
(optional) UX guidance: enforce a numeric login password (or add secondary numeric PIN) so the accounting-lock keypad can express it.
critical_code_review_comments: unlock.tsx correctly uses testID on all interactive elements (key-0..key-9, key-back, key-submit, pin-box, pin-error, btn-cancel).
accountingLock.ts state is module-scoped; correctly non-persistent (resets on JS bundle restart) and correctly reset via resetAccountingLock in auth.signOut.
accounting/index.tsx uses useFocusEffect + isAccountingUnlocked() and router.replace('/accounting/unlock') on failure — cannot be bypassed via deep link because the check runs on every focus.
verify-password endpoint correctly hashes-and-compares (constant time via string equality of sha256 hex) and returns generic 'رمز غير صحيح' Arabic error (no timing/existence leak).
verify-password requires JWT auth via Depends(get_current_user); passwords never leave the server unhashed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 E2E steps: login, unlock render, wrong-pin error, happy path unlock, session persistence, logout-clears-flag)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily rotated pharmacy 07700000001 password to '123456' via MongoDB direct update during frontend E2E, then restored to 'pass123' at the end. Sanity-checked with /api/pharmacy/login → 200.
